messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "prevent choking"
set: ["prevent choking", "avoid choking or gagging", "prevent dehydration", "to prevent dizziness", "this does not usually prevent their use", "follow special diet to help prevent kidney stones", "prevent dialing full dose after 4 weekly doses", "use non-hormone birth control method to prevent pregnancy", "take tablets after meals to help prevent stomach upset", "store in safe place to prevent stealing or abuse", "get up slowly and steady yourself to prevent a fall", "avoid sudden standing from sitting or lying position to prevent dizziness", "use extra care to prevent bleeding while shaving or brushing teeth", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting", "use 2 inhalations 15 to 30 minutes before you exercise to prevent exercise-induced bronchospasm", "do not use to prevent hives from known causes such as foods, insect stings, or medicines"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
